algebra.expression: T_small o C_gray o N o B_boundary o P_72 (KellerSegel_480)
algebra.convention: Operators compose right to left; each selection acts on the current SVG result. These are discrete geometric operators, not identities in a vector space.

operators.P_72: Convert alternating contour paths into 72-sample polygons, deliberately coarsening their geometry.
operators.B_boundary: Set all contour and polygon fills to none.
operators.N: Spline and differentiate the sampled polygon boundaries into line bundles.
operators.C_gray: Map all resulting contour marks to neutral grays.

algebra.orderMatters: Selection, conversion and spline replacement change the domain available to subsequent operators. Color before geometry is inherited by new marks; color after geometry enumerates the newly created marks.
